title: Göbekli Tepe built and buried by survivors of a cataclysm

tellings.quote: Gobeclete in Turkey where we attributed that area to just hunter gatherers then lo and behold this you know incredible ancient the oldest megalithic temple site pops up out of the ground

plain: Göbekli Tepe, a site in Turkey that scholars had put down to simple hunter-gatherers, turned out to hold what a researcher named Jay Anderson calls the oldest megalithic temple site, a place of huge carved stones that 'pops up out of the ground'. Anderson says this on the show without naming a source. The story's larger claim is that survivors of an ancient catastrophe built the site and then buried it, which would mean a lost chapter of human history.
